apps.title: TXT to EPUB - eBook Converter
apps.description:
TxtToEpub is a tool for turning TXT novels into EPUB ebooks, especially for users who want to read TXT content in Apple Books, Kindle, and other reading apps.

It addresses several common problems: Apple Books does not support TXT directly; TXT novels usually lack the structured table of contents and navigation metadata required by reading apps, so chapter titles in plain text still do not provide efficient navigation after import; and raw TXT files often fall short in layout quality, encoding consistency, and ebook completeness, which can result in garbled text, inaccurate chapter detection, missing covers, and an incomplete cross-device reading experience.

Typical use cases
* Convert TXT novels into standard EPUB files for Apple Books, Kindle, and other reading apps
* Fix garbled text and handle common encoding differences
* Detect chapter headings and split long novels automatically to reduce manual cleanup
* Generate a navigable table of contents for TXT files that lack structured TOC data
* Reformat plain TXT novels with better headings, paragraphs, spacing, and reading flow
* Convert between Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese for different reading preferences
* Add covers, themes, and chapter header artwork for a more consistent book presentation
* Use 39 cover templates or create custom AI-generated cover art
* Send the processed EPUB to Kindle or import it into other ebook readers

Core features
* TXT to EPUB conversion
* Chapter detection, auto chapter split, and TOC generation
* Garbled text fix and common encoding handling
* Novel formatting with horizontal and vertical layouts
* 8 reading themes with live preview
* Chapter header images, stickers, and custom images
* 39 cover templates with support for custom AI-generated cover art
* Chinese conversion and Kindle send
* Mostly local processing for stability and privacy

Best for
* Users who want to read TXT novels in Apple Books or Kindle
* Web novel readers who want to turn plain TXT into EPUB with a usable table of contents
* Users who need garbled text fix, chapter cleanup, and layout improvement
* Writers and editors who need ebook formatting and cover creation

TxtToEpub is not just a file converter. It helps turn TXT novels with limited structure, rough layout, and weak navigation into EPUB ebooks that are better suited for long-form reading.

• EPUB to Word
Create an editable DOCX document with supported chapters, text, and images.

• EPUB to PDF
Generate a PDF that is easier to share, annotate, and print.

• EPUB to TXT
Extract chapter titles and body text into a clean plain-text file.

• EPUB to Markdown
Create a Markdown file and an additional ZIP package containing the Markdown document and its image assets.

• Extract book images

• Turn an EPUB manuscript into an editable Word document
• Convert an ebook to PDF for annotation or printing
• Move EPUB content into a Markdown knowledge base
• Extract covers and illustrations from books or study material
• Convert private files without uploading them to a conversion server

Every new user can complete three successful conversions at no charge. Upgrade to EPUB Converter Pro to unlock unlimited exports.
